verses.1: Who is wise? Who knows all the secrets of human wisdom? It will shine upon his face, and his courage will be restored.
verses.2: I am Piy-Melech Shmur, and I speak according to the words of God.
verses.3: Do not be afraid of him. Do not stand in opposition to his words. For everything that he does, he will do it anyway.
verses.4: When the king’s words are given, and who can say to him, “What shall you do?”
verses.5: One who obeys commands will never know anything bad. And in judging, a wise heart will always be able to make the right decision.
verses.6: For every person’s desires, there is a time and a judgment. The evil that a person does is too great for him to bear.
verses.7: Because he doesn’t know what will happen. When he does appear, who will tell him?
verses.8: There is no one who can rule over the winds. There is no control over death, and there is no way to command someone to fight in battle. Nor can one conquer evil with one’s own strength.
verses.9: I saw all this, and I gave my heart to every action that took place under the sun, during the time when man ruled over man in a cruel manner.
verses.10: And so, I saw that the wicked were buried and went away from the holy place. They disappeared from that city. They did the same thing here as well.
verses.11: Since no harm can be done quickly, therefore, people’s hearts are filled with a desire to do evil.
verses.12: He who sins does evil to himself. But I will reward him, because I know that what is good will happen to those who fear God. They will be feared by Him.
verses.13: And no good will come to the wicked, and they will not live long like a moth that does not fear God.
verses.14: There is also a “dishonor” that occurs on the earth. There are righteous people who receive what the wicked receive as punishment. And there are wicked people who receive what the righteous receive as reward. I said that this is also a form of dishonor.
verses.15: And I praise the joy that comes from eating and drinking, and from being happy. For under the sun, there is nothing better for a person than to eat and drink, and to be happy. And he will rejoice in his efforts during his lifetime, as God has given him those things under the sun.
verses.16: When I was given the ability to understand wisdom and to see the problems that have arisen on the earth, even during day and night, he still cannot see them.
verses.17: And I saw all of God’s works. It is impossible for humans to understand the works that take place under the sun, even though they try hard to comprehend them. And even if a wise person tries to understand them, it is still impossible for him to do so.
